description: Use after mcp_tools_check when the user wants a review report or to see what changed since approval. Pass document (current tools/list response or Agent Card) and optionally previous (the approved version). Returns every flag with an action, a priority, OWASP and MCP Security Audit Kit references, a change comparison (added, removed and changed tools with the changed fields) and an inventory row. Requires ClevSec Pro.

document.description: The JSON to check: a tools/list response (JSON-RPC response, its result, or the tools array) or an A2A Agent Card.

previous.description: Optional: the previously approved version, to compare.

public.description: A2A only: true if the agent is deliberately public (no authentication by design).

name: mcp_tools_report
title: MCP tool list and Agent Card report (ClevSec Pro)
